CMU Flite voice notice
======================

The packaged `first_kill.wav` and `one_more_kill.wav` announcements were
synthesized offline from original phrases with the CMU Flite `rms` voice and
then mixed with original short tones. No Flite code, runtime TTS engine or
downloaded recording is included in the game.

Flite source and voice data notice (from the Debian Flite copyright record):

Copyright (c) 1999-2001 Language Technologies Institute,
Carnegie Mellon University. All Rights Reserved.
